The preview imports only objective text via tools/import_poe2_act1.py.
The generated JSON records the source SHA-256. Scripts in this HTML are
never executed. Claimed patch 0.5.5 compatibility has not been independently
validated. The page contains additional notes that are not imported,
including league-specific and build-specific advice.

Updating this source requires reviewing progression/rewards against the
target live patch, updating the pinned revision/checksum, regenerating the
JSON and checking the route/replay tests. Merely downloading a new page
is not evidence of game compatibility.
